hero.title: A Safe Space to Speak Up
hero.subtitle: We are here to listen, support, and protect. Do not hesitate to report any incidents you have experienced or witnessed.

howItWorks.title: How SafePlace Works?
howItWorks.step1_desc: Report anonymously or with an account, according to your comfort.
howItWorks.step2_desc: Fill out the report form safely and securely with encryption.
howItWorks.step3_desc: Our consultants are ready to assist your next steps.

security.title: Top Tier Security & Privacy
security.feature1_desc: Report without leaving any identity traces.
security.feature2_desc: All data is secured with high-level encryption.
security.feature3_desc: Only authorized parties can view your identity (if permitted).
security.feature4_desc: A panic button is available to instantly close this page.

campus.title: Make Your Campus Safer
campus.subtitle: Join the SafePlace network to provide better protection for students.

start.title: Choose Reporting Path
start.subtitle: Both are equally secure.
start.anonymous_desc: Your identity is hidden. You will receive a unique code to track the report status.
start.identified_desc: Use your account. Facilitates further communication if needed.

mode.title: Who is Reporting?
mode.victim_desc: I am reporting an incident I experienced myself.
mode.witness_title: I am Reporting for Someone Else
mode.witness_desc: I am reporting an incident experienced by someone else (witness/companion).
mode.witness_consent: Ensure you have obtained consent from the victim if possible.
